name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 1-pixel solid #005FCC focus ring with a 2-pixel outer glow at 20% opacity on all focusable elements. This ensures keyboard users see where they are without breaking the page’s color scheme. The glow improves visibility on light backgrounds where a solid ring might blend in. Trade-off: the glow adds slight blur that some users may dislike, but it’s a small cost for universal clarity.

name: Reader
text: The 20% glow fails WCAG 2.2 AA on light backgrounds—#005FCC at 20% opacity drops to ~1.8:1 contrast against white, invisible to many users. A better fix: use a 2px solid ring at 4.5:1 contrast (#005FCC) with a 1px inner shadow at 50% opacity to soften edges without sacrificing clarity. Settle it with a live contrast test on a busy background.
